That crash was caused by isolating 67 libraries rather than 2: libtttext_lite.so has seven weak undefined pthread_* references, and a weak symbol that does not resolve binds to zero, so calling it gives SIGSEGV at address 0 with frame #00 'Not mapped'. Neither the non-isolated run nor the two-library run shows it.

the 67-library set was the wrong closure: it listed every library that REACHES libc++_shared.so through DT_NEEDED, when the fix needs the forward closure of the library that actually failed, which is libvision_core.so plus libc++_shared.so.
toutiao.still_open: why the feed content area is empty. Not a transport failure: the app's uid holds four HTTPS connections, three ESTABLISHED and stable, 23 socket fds, no retry loop. The prior diagnosis stands and is well evidenced -- no article cells in the adapter, every IConnectivityManager call answered, DNS/routing/TCP confirmed working -- and attributes the emptiness to the app's anti-abuse layer rejecting the environment. Today adds one detail: a peer resolving to an AWS us-west-2 edge, which suggests the rejected environment may include apparent region.
toutiao.not_a_gap_until_shown: an app showing no content is only a platform gap if the platform caused it. Counting this one before the response is read would inflate the map with something no shim can fix.

method_note_isolation: --android-native-target moves a library into an isolated Android namespace so DT_NEEDED picks the APK's copy. Isolating more than necessary is not free: a library whose weak libc references resolve in the default namespace can find them unresolved in the isolated one, and a weak symbol binds to zero rather than failing the load. Use the forward dependency closure of the library that failed, not every library that reaches the shadowed one.
method_note_network: There is no app-level network instrument and none was needed: the OS owns the sockets. /proc/<pid>/net/tcp6 gives per-connection state and the owning uid, netstat names the peers, and sampling twice distinguishes an idle keep-alive from a retry loop. No xt_qtaguid or BPF accounting on this board, so per-uid byte totals are not available and the netns TCP counters are system-wide -- they cannot be attributed to one app.
